documents.title: Master Services Agreement
documents.text:
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement ('Agreement') is entered into as of January 15, 2024, by and between CloudScale AI Corp ('Vendor') and Acme Enterprise Corp ('Customer').

RECITALS
WHEREAS, Vendor provides cloud intelligence infrastructure services;
WHEREAS, Customer desires to procure said services pursuant to the terms herein;

OPERATIVE PROVISIONS

Section 1. Definitions.
'Services' means cloud infrastructure.

Section 4. Payment Terms.
Section 4.1 Invoicing and Payment. Vendor shall invoice Customer monthly. All invoices shall be paid Net 30 days from the date of the invoice. Late payments shall accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

Section 8. Limitation of Liability.
Section 8.1 Liability Cap. In no event shall aggregate liability exceed the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

Section 12. Governing Law.
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of California.

documents.title: Amendment No. 1 to Master Services Agreement
documents.text:
AMENDMENT NO. 1

This Amendment No. 1 to that certain Master Services Agreement dated January 15, 2024 ('Agreement') is entered into by and between CloudScale AI Corp and Acme Enterprise Corp, effective June 1, 2024.

Section 4.1 is hereby amended and replaced to read as follows:
'All invoices shall be paid Net 60 days from date of receipt by Customer. Delinquent amounts shall accrue interest at 1.0% per month.'

Except as expressly modified by this Amendment, all other terms of the Agreement remain in full force and effect.

CLOUD PLATFORM AGREEMENT

Between DataFlow Networks LLC and Acme Corp, effective March 1, 2024.

Section 8. Limitation of Liability.

documents.title: Schedule C - Data Security Addendum
documents.text:
SCHEDULE C
DATA SECURITY ADDENDUM

This Schedule C is incorporated by reference into that certain Cloud Platform Agreement between DataFlow Networks LLC and Acme Corp.

Section C.1 Liability Carve-Out.
Except as expressly modified by this Schedule C, Section 8.1 remains in effect. Notwithstanding Section 8.1 of the Agreement, liability for Data Protection Breaches shall not be subject to the 12-month cap and shall be capped at $5,000,000.
